meta.name: review
meta.description: Review a proposed customer code change against its intended outcome and operational risks. Use for a diff or PR review; report evidence and actionable findings.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照预期目标与运行风险审读代码改动,给出有证据、可落地的审查结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次有人提交代码改动,都需要先弄清它是否达到预期、会不会带来运行风险
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every incoming diff needs a risk-and-intent check before it ships

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会审查一份提交的客户代码改动(diff 或 PR),对照它想达成的预期结果和运行风险,给出证据和可执行的发现。它直接从你提供的上下文入手,不需要初始化或建工作目录。
howto.when: 当你要审查一份 diff 或 PR 时触发。若被 @fde 调用,则复用其当前的脱敏数据包与范围,不重启设置、不重复已答过的问题。

say.text: 审查这个 PR,对照它的预期结果列出风险
say.note: 输出证据和可执行的发现

say.text: 这是客户代码的 diff,帮我看看运行风险
say.note: 基于你提供的上下文分析

say.text: 没跑过的检查请如实标注,别当成已验证

howto.what_en: Reviews a proposed customer code change (a diff or PR) against its intended outcome and operational risks, reporting evidence and actionable findings. It works from the supplied context; no initialization or engagement folder is needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you supply a diff or PR for review. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or re-asking answered questions.

say_en.text: Review this PR against its intended outcome and list the risks.
Here's the customer diff — check it for operational risks.
Flag checks that weren't run instead of treating them as verified.
